description: Return the Zotero data model so you never hardcode item shapes. With no arguments, returns the schema version and the list of all item type names. With `item_type`, returns the valid fields and creator types for that type (the "primary" creator type is listed first). Use this to validate an item before creating or updating it: notes, attachments, and annotations are item types too but bypass the normal field/creator model.

item_type.description: If set, return the fields & creator types for this item type.

name: zotero_schema

creatorTypes.description: Valid creator types for it, primary first.

fields.description: Valid field names for that item type.

itemTypes.description: Every item type name; returned when no item_type was given.

version.description: Zotero schema version this answer came from.

title: Zotero data model (types & fields)
